phases.note: Old blockers updated: A routingEvidence, shared ranker wiring and decision HTTP are all on main; C library changes keep main's decision integration green.

Shared AttentionRanker unchanged in semantics: sinceAt=null unknown, deadlineAt only for business deadlines with a 24h near window, expiresAt is validity not a deadline, blockedWorkIds is outgoing, complete stable permutation of input ids.

Removed silent 1000-record/4-batch caps. Project scans are complete or throw DecisionError('scan_incomplete'); targeted supersession probe is used for single records and refuses when its budget is exceeded. listEffectiveWindow reports caller-cap truncation separately. Supersession is historical: revoking a replacement does not reactivate the older decision.

Real temporary SQLite through A RoutingEvidencePort: advice/review/outcome same-body replay, changed-body conflict, project isolation, exact-subject and exact-profile filters, trigger-failure rollback, reopen persistence, candidate/reviewer drift -> stale while audit stays. In-memory fixture no longer used as port evidence.

Library-level closed loop: bounded context preview (untrusted data, injection flagged) -> structured proposal prepare (read-only) -> persist pending -> explicit confirmation -> planProposalCommand maps the intent to the existing UserCommand -> decision command commits synchronously in one UnitOfWork with event+receipt. Missing scope/criteria/profile or a full revision contract returns needs_user_input; nothing executes before confirmation.

Negatives: unconfirmed/drifted grant/actor/scope/source/version, rejected proposal, duplicate confirmation/command, receipt-failure rollback (decision+event+receipt), reopen, supersede then revoke without resurrection, source missing/stale, same-id body conflict, incomplete scan refusal.
Documents stable exports, scan-budget policy, supersession history semantics, command-plan contract, main recipes and remaining non-C work.
